name: Cholera & mosquito-borne
summary: Cholera deaths in DR Congo near 1,800 alongside Ebola; record dengue seasons
state: WHO reported about 1,800 cholera deaths in DR Congo in early November, with cases near 60,000, as the country also fights Ebola (AFP via Medical Xpress). MSF warns the epidemic is worsening. This approaches the Alert line for high-mortality outbreaks in conflict zones, but no WHO grade 3 declaration was found and a second trusted outlet could not be confirmed as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Travellers to affected areas should follow NHS Fit for Travel and WHO advice on safe water and food.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks short of confirmed grade 3 = Watch; Alert unconfirmed

sources.title: Medical Xpress — Some 1,800 dead from cholera in Ebola-hit DR Congo: WHO
Eastleigh Voice — MSF raises alarm over worsening cholera epidemic in DRC

why: Climate-sensitive diseases — cholera, dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche, West Nile and yellow fever — are hitting record levels and reaching new regions.
drivers: Conflict, floods, heat, El Niño, water and sanitation, mosquito range expansion.

rubric.alert: Large outbreaks with high mortality in conflict zones, or a WHO grade 3 emergency.
rubric.watch: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).
